description: Verify that DUT acknowledges tester ISN by emitting SYN,ACK with ack_num == tester_seq + 1 (RFC 793 §3.1)
approach:
[Objective]
The SYN consumes one sequence number; DUT's SYN,ACK must ack tester_isn + 1.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN with seq=I.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK with ack_num == I+1.

[Pass condition]
SYN,ACK ack_num == tester ISN + 1.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_ack_num — ack_num does not equal I+1
• Fail_timeout — no SYN,ACK

verdicts.Fail_wrong_ack_num: DUT SYN,ACK ack_num does not acknowledge tester ISN
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN,ACK within listen window
